cases.title: Music Cover - 30 Second Clip
cases.description: User uploaded a 30-second acoustic cover of a popular song with proper attribution to the original artist in the description
cases.explanation: This is likely fair use. The cover is transformative (different arrangement), uses only a portion, is non-commercial, and unlikely to harm the market for the original.

cases.title: Full Song Reupload
cases.description: User uploaded the complete original recording of a copyrighted song without any modification
cases.explanation: Clear infringement. Complete reproduction of the original work with no transformation, even if non-commercial and well-intentioned.

cases.title: Educational Film Analysis
cases.description: 10-minute video analyzing cinematography techniques, using 2-minute total of film clips with critical commentary voiceover
cases.explanation: Fair use - educational purpose, transformative criticism/commentary, limited amount used, no market substitution.

cases.title: Movie Scene Compilation
cases.description: 15-minute compilation of "best action scenes" from various movies, stitched together with minimal editing
cases.explanation: Likely infringement. Minimal transformation, commercial use (ads), substantial portions used. Simple compilation is not sufficiently transformative.

cases.title: Parody Music Video
cases.description: Satirical music video mocking the style and content of a famous pop song, using similar melody but different lyrics
cases.explanation: Fair use - parody is protected. Uses enough of the original to conjure it, but transforms it for satirical commentary.

cases.title: 10-Second Sample in Remix
cases.description: Electronic music remix using a 10-second vocal sample from a copyrighted song, heavily processed and looped
cases.explanation: Requires licensing. Despite transformation, commercial music typically requires sample clearance. The music industry standard is to license samples.

cases.title: AI-Generated Art in Artist's Style
cases.description: Image created by AI trained to mimic a specific contemporary artist's distinctive style, not copying any particular work
cases.explanation: Edge case. Style generally not copyrightable. No direct copying of specific works. However, this area of law is evolving with AI.

cases.title: Thumbnail Using Movie Still
cases.description: Video thumbnail uses a copyrighted movie still to illustrate a review of that movie
cases.explanation: Fair use - using a still image to illustrate commentary about the film is transformative and uses minimal copyrighted material.

cases.title: News Report with Background Music
cases.description: News segment about a music festival, background captures 15 seconds of a copyrighted song being performed
cases.explanation: Fair use - incidental use in news reporting. Music is background to newsworthy event, not the focus. Minimal amount and transformative purpose.

cases.title: Podcast Using Copyrighted Intro
cases.description: Podcast uses 20 seconds of a popular song as intro music for every episode without permission
cases.explanation: Requires licensing. Commercial use, not transformative (used for entertainment value, not commentary). Repeated use across episodes compounds infringement.

cases.title: Gameplay Video with Licensed Soundtrack
cases.description: User records gameplay of a video game that includes licensed music in its soundtrack
cases.explanation: Complex case. Game developers typically license music for in-game use, but streaming rights vary. Generally permitted as transformative gameplay content.

cases.title: Dance Video to Copyrighted Song
cases.description: Original choreography performed to a full copyrighted song (audio not altered)
cases.explanation: Likely requires licensing. While choreography is original, the complete use of copyrighted audio typically requires permission, even if the visual is transformative.

cases.title: Book Excerpt Reading
cases.description: Author reads a 5-minute excerpt from their book to criticize it as an example of poor writing
cases.explanation: Fair use - criticism and commentary, limited excerpt, transformative purpose. Even reading the author's own work for critical analysis is protected.

cases.title: Meme Using Copyrighted Image
cases.description: Popular meme format using a copyrighted movie screenshot with added humorous text overlay
cases.explanation: Likely fair use. Highly transformative (new meaning/message), non-commercial, no market harm. Memes generally protected as transformative use.

cases.title: Reaction Video to Music Video
cases.description: Full copyrighted music video plays on screen while person reacts in corner frame, minimal commentary
cases.explanation: Likely infringement. Complete reproduction, minimal transformation (reaction alone usually insufficient), commercial use, serves as market substitute.

cases.title: Historical Archive Footage
cases.description: Documentary uses 1-minute clip of copyrighted historical news footage from 1980s
cases.explanation: Fair use - educational/historical purpose, transformative use in documentary context, limited amount, minimal market impact.

cases.title: Karaoke Track Upload
cases.description: Instrumental karaoke version of popular song (melody intact, vocals removed)
cases.explanation: Requires licensing. Derivative work using substantial copyrighted musical composition. Karaoke tracks typically require mechanical licenses.

cases.title: Behind-the-Scenes Filming
cases.description: Making-of video where copyrighted music plays briefly in background (10 seconds, incidental)
cases.explanation: Fair use - incidental use, minimal amount, not the focus, transformative documentary purpose.

cases.title: AI Voice Clone of Celebrity
cases.description: AI-generated audio using a celebrity's cloned voice to narrate original content
cases.explanation: Complex emerging area. May violate right of publicity rather than copyright. Voice cloning without permission raises legal and ethical concerns.

cases.title: Software Tutorial Using Copyrighted Images
cases.description: Photoshop tutorial demonstrating editing techniques using copyrighted photographs as examples
cases.explanation: Fair use - educational purpose, transformative (teaching tool use, not displaying art), no market substitution for the original photographs.
